title: WindCharge Reset
description: WindCharge Reset is a Minemen-inspired Paper plugin that lets falling players use Wind Charges to reset their downward momentum and stop mid-air.
body:
# 🌪️ WindCharge Reset

**WindCharge Reset** is a lightweight Paper plugin that adds a **Minemen-inspired Wind Charge momentum reset mechanic** to your Minecraft server.

Normally, when a player uses a Wind Charge while falling, it just launches in the direction they are looking.
This plugin changes that interaction into a clean PvP movement feature: when a player is falling, airborne, and uses a Wind Charge under themselves, their downward momentum gets reduced or reset.

This creates a smooth mid-air stop mechanic that feels natural, competitive, and perfect for modern PvP servers.

> Inspired by Minemen-style movement mechanics.
> This project is not affiliated with Minemen.

---

## ✨ Features

* 🌪️ Minemen-inspired Wind Charge reset mechanic
* 🪂 Works while the player is airborne and falling
* ⬇️ Detects when the player is looking downward
* ⚡ Resets or reduces falling momentum
* 🛑 Allows clean mid-air stops and clutch plays
* 🛠️ Configurable cooldown, strength, pitch angle, and velocity behavior
* 💨 Optional particles and sound effects
* 🚀 Lightweight and performance-friendly
* ⚔️ Great for PvP, practice, duels, SMPs, and movement-based servers

---

## 🎮 How it works

When a player is:

* 🪂 in the air
* ⬇️ falling down
* 👀 looking downward
* 🌪️ using a Wind Charge

…the plugin triggers a custom momentum reset effect.

Instead of the Wind Charge simply flying downward, the player receives a controlled velocity adjustment that reduces their fall speed or stops them mid-air.

This makes Wind Charges feel more useful, skill-based, and satisfying in PvP.

---

## 💥 Why use this?

Wind Charges are already one of the most interesting movement items in modern Minecraft.
**WindCharge Reset** makes them even better by adding a clean way to control falling momentum.

Players can use it to:

* 🛑 stop mid-air
* 🪂 reduce fall speed
* ⚔️ clutch during fights
* 🔥 create better movement combos
* 🧠 make PvP feel more skill-based
* 🎯 practice Wind Charge movement tech
* 🌪️ make Wind Charges more useful on your server

---

## ⚙️ Configuration

The plugin is designed to be fully configurable, including:

* ⬇️ minimum falling speed required
* 👀 minimum downward pitch angle
* ⏱️ cooldown between resets
* ⚡ vertical reset strength
* 🧭 horizontal velocity multiplier
* 🌪️ whether the Wind Charge should be consumed
* 💨 particles
* 🔊 sounds

---

## 🧩 Recommended for

* ⚔️ PvP practice servers
* 🥊 Duels servers
* 🌍 SMP servers
* 🔨 Mace / Wind Charge PvP servers
* 🪂 Movement practice servers
* 🎯 Minemen-style combat servers

---

## 🎯 Plugin goal

WindCharge Reset is designed to be simple, clean, and focused on one mechanic only:

> 🌪️ Use a Wind Charge while falling to reset your momentum and stop mid-air.

No bloat.
No random systems.
Just a clean Wind Charge movement mechanic for modern PvP.
